context.en: The 1609 book portrait gives Cao Cao a ceremonial cap and posthumous title. Compare this later image of authority with the commander’s manoeuvres in the account.
context.zh: 1609年书籍肖像以礼冠与追尊庙号呈现曹操；可把这幅后世权威形象与记载中的指挥行动对照。

context.en: Sun Quan stands with attendants in a later imperial portrait. The image represents the ruler whose fortified position and diplomacy shaped this encounter.
context.zh: 后世帝王图中孙权与侍者并立，呈现本条筑城防御与交涉行动所围绕的统治者。

context.en: The later imperial portrait shows Liu Bei with attendants. Its composed court image contrasts with the hurried retreat and loss described in his biography.
context.zh: 后世帝王肖像中刘备与侍者相伴；安定的宫廷形象与传记中的仓促撤退及损失形成对照。

context.en: The Ming portrait gives Zhang Fei a later commemorative likeness. Read it alongside the text’s account of a rear guard of twenty riders rather than a solitary defender.
context.zh: 明代肖像为张飞赋予后世纪念形象；可与传记所记二十骑断后相读，而非把他想成孤身守桥。

context.en: The later portrait presents Liu Bei as an emperor. Here he appears in the text as the commander who ordered Huang Zhong’s attack, before his imperial accession.
context.zh: 后世肖像以帝王形象呈现刘备；本条文字中的他则是命黄忠进攻的统帅，当时尚未称帝。
